versions.changelog:
Initial release of revid-pdf-to-video

- Create short summary videos from public PDF URLs (whitepapers, research papers, slide decks, ebooks).
- Supports custom prompts to focus summaries on user-specified sections.
- Allows optional aspect ratio and video duration settings.
- Outlines API usage and failure troubleshooting.
- Must upload local PDFs to public storage for processing.
- Linked to related skills for HTML articles and advanced media control.
